HabsburgMiningExpedition.additionalLossCondition: At the end of the {Fast} Phase, the Invaders win if any land has at least 8 total Invaders/{Blight} (combined).

additionalGameEffectBodies: Lands with 3 or more Invaders are Mining lands. In Mining lands:{BR}{Bullet}{Disease} and modifiers to {Disease} affect Ravage Actions as though they were Build Actions.{EndBullet}{BR}{Bullet}During the Build Step, Build Cards cause Ravage Actions (instead of Build Actions).{EndBullet}
levels.gameEffectBody: When {Blight} added by a Ravage Action would cascade, instead Upgrade 1 {Explorer}/{Town} (before {Dahan} counterattack).
<u>Setup:</u> Add 1 {Explorer} in each land with no {Dahan}. On each board, Add <nobr>1 {Disease}</nobr> and <nobr>1 {City}</nobr> in the highest-numbered land with a {Town} Setup symbol.
levels.gameEffectTitle: Miners Come From Far and Wide

levels.gameEffectBody: After the Build Step, on each board: Choose a land with {Explorer}. Upgrade 1 {Explorer} there.

flippedBody: This card cannot be removed from the Invader deck
additionalInvaderCards.title: Salt Deposits

levels.gameEffectBody: Setup: Remove the Stage II “Coastal Lands” card before randomly choosing Stage II cards. Place the “Salt Deposits” card in place of the 2nd Stage II card.{BR}(New Deck Order: 111-2S22-33333, where S is the Salt Deposits card. {Escalation} ignores S.)
Instead of Mining Boom (I), after the Build Step, on each board: Choose a land with {Explorer}. Build there, then Upgrade 1 {Explorer}. (Build normally in a Mining land.)
<u>Setup and During the Explore Step:</u> On boards with 3 or fewer {Blight}, Add +1 {Explorer} in each land successfully explored. (Max. 2 lands per board per Explore Card.)

HabsburgMiningExpedition.stageIIEscalationBody: After Advancing Invader Cards: On each board, Explore in 2 lands whose terrains don't match a Ravage or Build Card (no source required).
HabsburgMiningExpedition.title: Habsburg Mining Expedition

TheHabsburgMonarchy.additionalLossCondition: Track how many {Blight} come off the Blight Card during Ravages that do 6+ overkill to the land. If that number ever exceeds players, the Invaders win.

levels.gameEffectBody: After the normal Build Step: In each land matching a Build Card, Gather 1 {Town} from a land not matching a Build Card. (In board/land order.)

During Setup, on each board, add 1 {Town} to land #2 and 1 {Town} to the highest-numbered land without Setup symbols. During Play, when Invaders would Build 1 {City} in an Inland land, they instead Build 2 {Town}.
When making the Invader Deck, Remove 1 additional Stage I Card.{BR}(New deck order: 11-2222-33333)

{Town} in lands without {Blight} are Durable: they have +2 Health, and “Destroy {Town}” effects instead deal 2 Damage (to those {Town} only) per {Town} they could Destroy. (”Destroy all {Town}“ works normally.)

Before the initial Explore, put the Habsburg Reminder Card under the top 5 Invader Cards. When revealed, on each board, add 1 {City} to a Coastal land without {City} and 1 {Town} to the 3 Inland lands with the fewest {Blight}.
Ravages do +2 Damage (total) if any adjacent lands have {Town}. (This does not cause lands without Invaders to Ravage.)

TheHabsburgMonarchy.stageIIEscalationBody: After Exploring: On each board with 4 or fewer {Blight}, add 1 {Town} to a land without {Town}/{Blight}. On each board with 2 or fewer {Blight}, do so again.
TheHabsburgMonarchy.title: The Habsburg Monarchy (Livestock Colony)

levels.gameEffectBody: During Setup, on each board add 1 {Town} to land #3.
When making the Invader Deck, put 1 of the Stage III cards between Stage I and Stage II.{BR}(New Deck Order: 111-3-2222-3333)
When making the Invader Deck, remove an additional Stage I card.{BR}(New Deck Order: 11-3-2222-3333)
When making the Invader Deck, remove an additional Stage II card.{BR}(New Deck Order: 11-3-222-3333)
When making the Invader Deck, remove an additional Stage I card.{BR}(New Deck Order: 1-3-222-3333)
When making the Invader Deck, remove all Stage I cards.{BR}(New Deck Order: 3-222-3333)

TheKingdomOfBrandenburgPrussia.stageIIEscalationBody: (Before Exploring) On each board with {Town}/{City}, add 1 {Town} to a land without {Town}.
TheKingdomOfBrandenburgPrussia.title: The Kingdom of Brandenburg-Prussia

TheKingdomOfEngland.additionalLossCondition: If 7 or more {Town}/{City} are ever in a single land, the Invaders win.

levels.gameEffectBody: Invader Build actions affect lands without Invaders, if they are adjacent to at least 2 {Town}/{City} before the Build Action.
During Setup, on each board add 1 {City} to land #1, and 1 {Town} to land #2.

Put the “High Immigration” tile on the Invader board, to the left of “Ravage”. The Invaders take this Build action each Invader phase before Ravaging. Cards slide left from Ravage to it, and from it to the discard pile. Remove the tile when a Stage II card slides onto it, putting that card in the discard.
The extra Build tile remains out the entire game.
{Town}/{City} have +1 Health.

During Setup, add an additional {Fear} to the Fear Pool per player in the game. During any Invader Phase where you resolve no Fear Cards, perform the Build from High Immigration twice. (This has no effect if no card is on the extra Build slot).

TheKingdomOfEngland.stageIIEscalationBody: On each board with {Town}/{City}, build in the land with the most {Town}/{City}.
TheKingdomOfEngland.title: The Kingdom of England

TheKingdomOfFrance.additionalLossCondition: There is a limit of <nobr>7 {Town}</nobr> per starting board. Invaders win if you ever cannot place <nobr>a {Town}.</nobr>

levels.gameEffectBody: Except during Setup: After Invaders successfully Explore into a land which had no {Town}/{City}, add 1 {Explorer} there.

During Setup, put the “Slave Rebellion” Event under the top 3 cards of the Event Deck. After Invaders Build in a land with 2 {Explorer} or more, replace all but 1 {Explorer} there with an equal number of {Town}.
During Setup, on each board add 1 {Town} to the highest-numbered land without {Town}. Add 1 {Town} to land #1.
Whenever Invaders Build a Coastal {City}, add 1 {Town} to the adjacent land with the fewest {Town}.
When you remove {Blight} from the board, put it here instead of onto the Blight Card. As soon as you have 3 {Blight} per player here, move it all back to the Blight Card.
After resolving an Explore Card, on each board add 1 {Explorer} to a land without any. Fear Card effects never remove {Explorer}. If one would, you may instead Push that {Explorer}.

TheKingdomOfFrance.stageIIEscalationBody: After Exploring, on each board, pick a land of the shown terrain. If it has {Town}/{City}, add 1 {Blight}. Otherwise, add 1 {Town}.
TheKingdomOfFrance.title: The Kingdom of France (Plantation Colony)

TheKingdomOfScotland.additionalLossCondition: If the number of Coastal lands with {City} is ever greater than (2 x # of boards), the Invaders win.

levels.gameEffectBody: After Setup, in Coastal lands, Explore Cards add 1 {Town} instead of 1 {Explorer}. <nobr>“Coastal Lands”</nobr> Invader Cards do this for maximum 2 lands per board.

During Setup, add 1 {City} to land #2. Place “Coastal Lands” as the 3rd Stage II Card, and move the two Stage II Cards above it up by one.{BR}(New Deck Order: 11-22-1-C2-33333, where C is the Stage II Coastal Lands Card.)
In Coastal lands, Build Cards affect lands without Invaders, so long as there is an adjacent {City}.
During Setup, replace the bottom Stage I Card with the bottom Stage III Card. (New Deck Order: 11-22-3-C2-3333)
After a Ravage Action adds {Blight} to a Coastal land, add 1 {Blight} to that board’s Ocean (without cascading). Treat the Ocean as a Coastal Wetland for this rule and for {Blight} removal/movement.
After the Ravage Step, add 1 {Town} to each Inland land that matches a Ravage Card and is within {1Range} of {Town}/{City}.

TheKingdomOfScotland.stageIIEscalationBody: On the single board with the most Coastal {Town}/{City}, add 1 {Town} to the N lands with the fewest {Town}. (N = # of players.)
TheKingdomOfScotland.title: The Kingdom of Scotland

levels.gameEffectBody: When a Ravage does 4+ overkill to the land, add an extra {Blight}. (This does not cause extra cascades / {Presence} destruction.)
During Setup, on each board add 1 {City} to land #4. On boards where land #4 starts with {Blight}, put that {Blight} in land #5 instead.
{Town} deal 3 Damage. {City} deal 5 Damage.
levels.gameEffectTitle: Fine Steel for Tools and Guns

levels.gameEffectBody: At the end of Setup, Accelerate the Invader Deck. (After the initial Explore, discard the topmost card of the lowest Invader Stage in the deck.) On each board, add 1 {Town} to the land matching the discarded card with the fewest Invaders.
When Ravaging adds at least 1 {Blight} to a land, also add 1 {Town} to an adjacent land without {Town}/{City}. Cascading {Blight} does not cause this effect.
During Setup, on each board add 1 {Town} and 1 {Blight} to land #8. The {Blight} comes from the box, not the Blight Card.

TheKingdomOfSweden.stageIIEscalationBody: After Invaders Explore into each land, if that land has at least as many Invaders as {Dahan}, replace 1 {Dahan} with 1 {Town}.
TheKingdomOfSweden.title: The Kingdom of Sweden

TheTsardomOfRussia.additionalLossCondition: Track {Beast} Destroyed by Adversary rules. If that number ever exceeds the number of {Beast} on the island, the Invaders win.

levels.gameEffectBody: During Setup, on each board, add 1 {Beast} and 1 {Explorer} to the highest-numbered land without {Town}/{City}. During Play, {Explorer} do +1 Damage. When Ravage adds {Blight} to a land (including cascades), Destroy 1 {Beast} in that land.
The first time each Action would Destroy {Explorer}: If possible, 1 of those {Explorer} is instead Pushed; 1 {Fear} when you do so.
Ravage Cards also match lands with 3 or more {Explorer}. (If the land already matched the Ravage Card, it still Ravages just once per Card. )
When making the Invader Deck, put 1 Stage III Card after each Stage II Card. (New Deck Order: 111-2-3-2-3-2-3-2-33)
Put an unused Stage II Invader Card under the top 3 Fear Cards, and an unused Stage III Card under the top 7 Fear Cards. When one is revealed, immediately place it in the Build space (face-up).
levels.gameEffectTitle: Entrench in the Face of Fear

levels.gameEffectBody: After the Ravage Step of turn 2+, on each board where it added no {Blight}: In the land with the most {Explorer} (min. 1), add 1 {Explorer} and 1 {Town}.

TheTsardomOfRussia.stageIIEscalationBody: On each board: Add 2 {Explorer} (total) among lands with {Beast}. If you can’t, instead add 2 {Explorer} among lands with {Beast} on a different board.
TheTsardomOfRussia.title: The Tsardom of Russia
